IL‐17‐mediated activation of colonic SEMFs may be involved in the pathogenesis of IBD.
IL‐17 is an inducer of C3 in human IBD mucosa.

IL‐17 induces the C3 mRNA expression through MAPKs and NF‐κB in the colonic SEMFs and that C3 mRNA expression is enhanced in the inflamed IBD mucosa, and these findings may provide new insights into the pathogenesis of IBD.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the increased C3 mRNA expression is a part of the IL‐17‐dependent inflammatory responses in the inflamed IBD mucosa.
C3 is induced in the IBD lesions through the IL‐17‐mediated activation of colonic SEMFs, and the C3 induction may play an important role in the pathogenesis of IBD.

the complement component C3 is a novel target of IL‐17, which may contribute to the pathogenesis of IBD.
